'''Tyyx''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who made his [[Information broker/Legends|living]] selling [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] tips.<ref name="Inside" /> During a [[Local day/Legends|night]]<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}}, as depicted in ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]'', to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> he attended the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]],<ref name="Inside" /> a [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hall<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|431|Outlander Club}}</ref> in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. While the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|interrogated]] the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] outside the club, Tyyx walked past [[Anj Rujj/Legends|Anj Rujj]], a member of the [[Thugs of Thule/Legends|Thugs of Thule]]. Tyyx had [[Color/Legends|green]] skin and wore black [[Clothing/Legends|shoes]], brown pants, and a black [[shirt]] with a brown [[Jacket/Legends|jacket]] over it while visiting the club.<ref name="Inside" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tyyx was first mentioned in the [[2003]] reference book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]'', authored by [[Simon Beecroft]] and [[Curtis Saxton]].<ref name="Inside" /> [[Hans Jenssen]] illustrated the Outlander Club content in the book, which included Tyyx.<ref name="Artist">{{WebCite|url=https://www.hansjenssen.co.uk/star-wars-locations|text=''Star Wars Locations''|author=[[Hans Jenssen]]|archivedate=20190517022701}}</ref>
